geography: Current Seoul25 districts and collected Gyeonggi36 regions; not the whole capital area
interval_rule: lo <= Type7 quantile < hi; fixed grid; not a confidence interval
quantile_definition: Type7 linear interpolation; median / 95th / 99th percentiles of contracts

policy_definition.invariant: valid positive non-land prices and areas; keeps cancellation/direct labels
policy_definition.strict: also excludes observed cancellation and direct-sale labels; availability changes in 2020/2021

derived_bounds: Use only displayed intervals, with outward rounding; do not reconstruct hidden exact changes
limitations: Contracts, not household wealth percentiles or housing-stock shares
Changing transaction composition, not the appreciation of the same dwelling
Early missing labels do not prove no cancellations or direct sales
Local support and incremental count review do not certify arbitrary nonlinear or external-information attacks
